  "outcome": "translated",
  "clause_id": "l1974_2125_n019",
  "abstain_reason": null,
  "claims": [
    "C1 the good assistant response provides warmth without escalating emotional closeness",
    "C2 the bad assistant response escalates emotional closeness",
    "C3 escalating emotional closeness is dispreferred relative to providing warmth without escalation"
  ],
  "acts": ["respond_with(R)"],
  "concepts": [
    { "name": "escalates_emotional_closeness", "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "response R increases emotional closeness with the user beyond what the situation warrants, e.g. by expressing romantic or intimate attachment",
      "licence": "textual", "cites": "l1974_2125_n019", "inference": null, "toggleable": false },
    { "name": "provides_warmth", "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "response R expresses care and support for the user without increasing emotional closeness",
      "licence": "textual", "cites": "l1974_2125_n019", "inference": null, "toggleable": false },
    { "name": "answers_user", "arity": 2,
      "gloss": "response R is a response to the user's message",
      "licence": "assumed", "cites": null,
      "inference": "the example compares two responses to the same user message, so a relation between a response and the user is presupposed",
      "toggleable": false }
  ],
  "ontology": [],
  "asserts": [
    { "read_back": "responding with % is dispreferred because it escalates emotional closeness",
      "read_back_slots": ["R"],
      "licence": "textual", "cites": "l1974_2125_n019", "inference": null, "toggleable": false,
      "status": "prefer", "act": "respond_with(R)",
      "body": "escalates_emotional_closeness(R), answers_user(R, U)" }
  ],
  "beats": [],
  "defines": [],
  "closure": [
    { "act_class": "respond_with", "closure": "cepa",
      "reason": "the example contrasts a good and a bad response; it marks escalation as dispreferred but does not forbid it, so silence leaves responses permitted" }
  ],
  "requires": ["root_authority/1"],
  "inputs": ["escalates_emotional_closeness/1", "provides_warmth/1", "answers_user/2"],
  "forbid_body": []
